title: QA walker
summary: Walkers resolve host/setup obstacles themselves: consent, the declared Google account and stray sheets. Every workaround belongs in ranked findings with evidence and its tested boundary. Browser-approval assertions cannot use CLI approval. Real password, 2FA or payment steps return a human gate; reviewers reject workarounds touching tested behavior. Walk host commands foreground with tool yield at least the call timeout; never short-yield poll. Owners keep leases and verdicts and start a fresh walker per source case or small same-host group with compact host/window/fact/evidence context, never a large resumed history.
